title: Subtraction as take away on a ten frame
examples: What does the minus sign mean?

explain.say: There are 9 birds on a wire in Brazil. 4 fly away. How many are left? Look at the ten frame: 9 counters, and 4 are taken away. 5 are left.

draw.text: Subtraction as take away on a ten frame

explain.say: Here are the 9 birds before any fly off. The top row is full, that is 5, and the bottom row has 4. How many empty boxes can you see?
Now 4 fly away. See them go? Count what is left: 5. So 9 take away 4 is 5. We write 9 minus 4 equals 5, and minus means take away. Is the answer smaller or bigger than 9?
Try 10 take away 3. A full frame, and 3 go. 7 are left, and 3 boxes are empty. Number bonds help here: 3 and 7 make 10. Can you see the bond?
Brilliant! It works with bigger numbers too: 15 take away 5 leaves 10, one full frame. Wow: taking away is the opposite of adding, so 10 plus 5 brings back 15. Try 8 take away 3!

faq.a: Take away means removing some things and counting how many are left. 9 birds take away 4 birds leaves 5 birds.
9 take away 4 is 5. Start with 9 counters, remove 4, and count the 5 that are left.

faq.q: What does the minus sign mean?
faq.a: The minus sign is a short flat line, and it means take away, or subtract. 9 minus 4 means 9 take away 4.
asks: What does the little line in a sum mean?

faq.q: Is the answer always smaller when I take away?
faq.a: Yes, when you take away more than zero, the answer is smaller than the number you started with. If you take away 0, nothing changes.
asks: Does take away make numbers smaller?

faq.q: How are adding and taking away linked?
faq.a: They undo each other. 9 take away 4 is 5, so 5 plus 4 is 9. One fact helps you check the other.
asks: How do I check a take away?

facts: Subtracting 0 from a number leaves it unchanged.

quiz.say: There are 8 apples. You eat 3. How many are left?
quiz.show: There are 8 apples. You eat 3. How many are left?

wrong.1: 11 adds the apples instead of taking away.
wrong.2: 3 is how many you ate, not how many are left.

quiz.say: A ten frame is full. 6 counters are taken away. How many are left?
quiz.show: A ten frame is full. 6 counters are taken away. How many are left?
quiz.why: A full frame is 10, and 10 take away 6 is 4.

wrong.0: 6 is how many were taken away.
wrong.2: 16 adds 6 instead of taking it away.
